implementation.design: _classify_wiki_error(stderr)：canonical 码直通（catalog_locked/catalog_busy/db_timeout/worker_paused/fatal）+ N-1 类名形态（CatalogOperationLockedError→catalog_locked；RuntimeError+paused→worker_paused）+ 非 JSON/未知→fatal（fail closed）。FilingFetchError.retryable 增加 catalog_busy/db_timeout；新增可选 stage/attempts。retry 集合={catalog_locked,catalog_busy,db_timeout}；worker_paused/fatal 不自动重试。退避=5s×2^n，±20% uniform jitter，cap 60s，wait=min(jittered, remaining)（无 sleep 超 deadline）；每 attempt 打印序号。stats（calls/downloads）贯穿 _run_company_wiki_json → retry → resolve_filing → main；成功信封带 calls/downloads，失败信封带 stage/attempts/calls/downloads。
